title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
key_facts: Amjad Masad, Replit's chief executive and co-founder, said on Thursday (15 Oct 2026) onstage at TechCrunch Disrupt that Replit is no longer working with Anthropic.
He gave cost, partnership and performance as reasons and said Replit's internal and public benchmarks show OpenAI models building vibe-coded apps from scratch better.
Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August; there had been no sign it had ended the Anthropic relationship.
A person familiar with the Anthropic-Replit partnership, who asked not to be named, said it was still in place.

A late-September Replit blog post cited Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Fable 5.1 as models in Replit Agent's production environment, and a Replit product employee posted about using Anthropic's Opus 5.5.
TechCrunch reached back out to Replit for clarification and will update.
Masad said enterprise was about 2% of Replit's revenue last year and about 15% this year, with more than 50% of revenue from B2B.
quote_evidence: Replit, the AI coding platform that has become a favorite of startup founders and developers, is no longer working with Anthropic, the company’s CEO and co-founder Amjad Masad said Thursday while onstage at TechCrunch Disrupt.
Masad’s comments were rejected by insiders familiar with the partnership between the Anthropic and Replit, however.
One person familiar, who asked not to be named, said the partnership was still in place.
why_it_matters_hint: A leading AI coding platform says it is dropping one model supplier for another, but the claim is contested.
event_date: Thursday 15 Oct 2026 (Disrupt remarks); article updated 16 Oct 2026
notes: Executive's claim contradicted by an anonymous insider and Replit's own recent posts; status DISPUTED.
